I.value_zh: v3 spec、Project._apply_init、lifecycle state、audit、现有测试、文档、MCP 工具描述、ISSUE-001 与现有夹生项目。
I.value_en: v3 spec, Project._apply_init, lifecycle state, audit, existing tests, docs, MCP tool descriptions, ISSUE-001 and existing partially migrated project.
I.notes_zh: 现有源码/磁盘状态待执行时核验。
I.notes_en: Existing source/disk state awaits execution-time verification.

O.value_zh: 3.0.2 修复、七项 init 测试、audit 扫描、同步文档/MCP 描述、CHANGELOG、REPORT/归档/ISSUE 关闭和迁移。
O.value_en: 3.0.2 fix, seven init tests, audit scan, synchronized docs/MCP descriptions, CHANGELOG, REPORT/archive/issue closure and migration.

A.value_zh: 修改 _apply_init、增加 lifecycle/audit 测试与扫描、更新文档/工具/版本、在分支测试后经人工批准发布；完成后写 REPORT-004、归档 TASK-004、关闭 ISSUE-001，并在本仓显式运行 migrate --to-v3。
A.value_en: Modify _apply_init, add lifecycle/audit tests and scan, update docs/tools/version, and release after tests and human approval on branch; afterward write REPORT-004, archive TASK-004, close ISSUE-001, and explicitly run migrate --to-v3 in this repository.
A.notes_zh: 审定不执行修改或迁移。
A.notes_en: Adjudication executes no modification or migration.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 钦定方案并须 mark_human_approved；ME 实施；CI 控制 merge。
P.value_en: ADMIN chooses solution and must mark_human_approved; ME implements; CI controls merge.
P.notes_zh: 任务身份不替代发布权限绑定。
P.notes_en: Task identity does not replace release authority binding.

R.value_zh: 原文未设执行期限或资源预算；P0/高风险为任务元数据，3.0.2 为版本，七项测试与 audit 状态为验收范围。
R.value_en: No execution deadline or resource budget is stated; P0/high risk is task metadata, 3.0.2 is the version, and seven tests and audit states delimit acceptance.
R.notes_zh: 高风险批准门保留在 P、B 与形式模型，不误归资源。
R.notes_en: The high-risk approval gate remains in P, B and the formal model rather than resources.

V.value_en: FCoP 3.0.0/3.0.1 spec §§1.1/6, ISSUE-001, TASK-004 proposal and Rule 7.

C.value_zh: 测试全绿，三种 init 产生五桶及三目录且不产生 tasks/log，audit P0/P1 正确，文档同步，CHANGELOG 落地，批准后才发布。
C.value_en: Tests pass, three init paths create five lifecycle buckets and three directories without tasks/log, audit P0/P1 is correct, docs sync, CHANGELOG lands, and release occurs only after approval.

B.value_zh: CI 不绿不得 merge；未批准不得发版；fresh v3 init 不得创建 v2 tasks/log；初始化修复不得自动改动既有项目，但完成后本仓显式迁移仍须执行。
B.value_en: Do not merge without green CI or release without approval; fresh v3 init must not create v2 tasks/log; the init fix must not automatically modify existing projects, while the explicitly required migration of this repository remains in scope.
